reviewRisk.reason: cross-screen async state, authoritative resource freshness, Attendance outcomes, and unknown mutation recovery

review.reviewer: Verify622 review was performed against the prior baseline; no fresh independent candidate-bound review exists for commit:e7ea1932

criteria.expected: One authoritative Program/cockpit resource; a committed Settings/Event/Schedule/Enrollment write is reflected in Overview, counts, next/open Event, and capability presentation without a full-page reload, and an older response cannot replace newer state.
criteria.actual: Single owner: ProgramWorkspace holds the department+modules+program+cockpit payload through useAsyncResource and refreshes it serialized on a queue (web/lib/programs/program-workspace.tsx:663-688); superseded refreshes settle as stale rather than leaving freshness unchanged (the earlier record's wording was wrong). Cockpit projects pending_enrollment_count/active_event_count/next_event/open_events (web/lib/programs/department-workspace.ts:1489-1586); Overview consumes open_events only when cockpit.program_id matches (web/lib/programs/workspace-task.tsx:412-419). Independent verifier ran the Worker cockpit projection test (pending=1, active_event_count=4, next_event = the open Event) and the useAsyncResource stale-result tests; the durable browser pair records the unchanged existing journeys 'settings, Event, and Enrollment mutations converge in Overview without reload' and 'keeps a successful Settings write distinct from a failed workspace readback' passing 33/33 at revision 3ae51b75. That predecessor-run evidence is retained as unchanged-journey applicability and is not relabelled as candidate a8f9b875; the candidate-only revision seam is covered by the focused Worker/component evidence.

criteria.expected: A confirmed write stays successful when the following read fails; visible data is marked stale with a read-only Retry that never replays the write; an unknown write outcome reconciles authoritative records before another mutation.
criteria.actual: Event Detail keeps the committed mutation and exposes Retry Refresh (web/lib/programs/event-detail.tsx:696-780, Retry at :1649-1651); Settings applies the PATCH result and marks reload-required/stale when the follow-up read fails (web/lib/programs/program-settings.tsx:2200-2248); unknown outcomes persist a recovery target and block dependent mutations (web/lib/programs/mutation-recovery.ts:141-173, :529-578); Attendance keeps a stale read-only projection and refuses mutations while stale/unknown (web/lib/attendance-operator-panel.tsx:1914-1919, :1996-2000, :2046-2050). Independent verifier re-ran the component cases; the unchanged real-route readback journey is preserved by the durable browser pair at revision 3ae51b75, while candidate a8f9b875's newer authoritative-revision seam is evidenced by the focused Worker/component tests rather than by relabelling that browser run.

criteria.expected: Program Detail and Overview keep an Active non-cancelled Event visible while its Check-In Window is open, even after start time; several open Events are presented as a truthful choice.
criteria.actual: The server open filter uses the Check-In Window, never starts_at (web/lib/programs/department-workspace.ts:1512-1522); Overview lists open_events with 'choose meeting' copy when more than one is open (web/lib/programs/workspace-task.tsx:477-552); participant detail keeps an Event visible while participant check-in remains open (web/lib/programs/participant-program-detail.tsx:90-93). Independent verifier ran the Worker time-boundary test (open Event started 30 minutes ago outranks a 2099 future Event; a cancelled future Event is excluded) and the component multiple-open-choice test.

criteria.expected: Package evidence is candidate-bound, and Worker/D1 tests exercise write-2xx-then-read-5xx, acknowledgement loss, out-of-order response, and current/open Event time boundaries; a fresh independent reviewer checks Spec plus Acceptance.
criteria.actual: Candidate e7ea1932 has candidate-bound Worker/D1 and component manifests: the full Worker suite passed 676/676 and the full component suite passed 1199/1199; the source seams cover readback failure, acknowledgement loss, and out-of-order responses. No fresh independent candidate-bound Spec plus Acceptance review is available, so R52 remains unverified.

limitations: Focused R52 Worker/D1 seam coverage passes at candidate e7ea1932; physical iPhone Safari / Android Chrome camera, downloaded-QR rescan, and native print remain unrun as the named completion gate shared with #625.

Two claims in the superseded 76ce0bd5 record were falsified and are corrected here: superseded refreshes settle as stale (not 'freshness unchanged'), and the cited program-settings.test.tsx:376-398 range is a Settings-group assertion, not a readback test.
Owner L2 approval, merge, deployment, release, and issue closure are outside this record.
The aggregate promotion verifier cannot run in this worktree because T05.7 requires a clean worktree and pre-existing unrelated documentation changes are deliberately preserved.
